newsitem.title: UK: Princess Diana richer than ex-husband Charles.
newsitem.headline: Princess Diana richer than ex-husband Charles.

text.p: Britain's Princess Diana is now richer than her ex-husband and future king Prince Charles thanks to a hefty divorce settlement and the death of her aristocrat father, according to a survey of the country's wealthiest people.

The annual Sunday Times survey of Britain's 1,000 richest people on Saturday estimated Diana's personal wealth at 17 million pounds ($27.7 million) -- some 15 million of which came from a divorce settlement last August.
Diana shares the 916th richest spot with cookery guru Delia Smith. But Prince Charles does not make the list because most of his wealth is counted under his mother Queen Elizabeth's name.

"She has more assets than he has in terms of what she now owns as a result of the divorce settlement.. Charles will not really control much until he becomes king," said Ian Coxon, Sunday Times managing editor.

A spokeswoman for Prince Charles said his personal wealth amounted to 4.9 million pounds last year. But because the income came from land under the Duchy of Cornwall which the prince holds as a steward rather than an outright owner, he is unable to sell any of its assets.
Princess Diana's 15-year marriage to Charles ended in an acrimonious struggle over the divorce settlement in which she relinquished the prestigious Her Royal Highness title.
She also inherited a substantial sum from the estate of her father Earl Spencer, who died in 1992.
The Sunday Times has kept the names of the top 10 richest people in Britain under wraps until publication on Sunday.
